description: The plot illustrates the average correct gate rate as a function of the embedding layer in a gated language model (LM). The x-axis represents the embedding layer, ranging from 0 to 30, and the y-axis represents the average correct gate rate, ranging from 0 to 1.0. The plot shows four lines representing different inputs: Character Attention input, Character MLP input, Wiki Attention input, and Wiki MLP input. The Character Attention input is represented by a solid blue line, the Character MLP input by a dashed blue line, the Wiki Attention input by a solid red line, and the Wiki MLP input by a dashed red line. The plot also includes shaded areas representing the standard deviation across 20 dataset partitions. The plot shows that the Character MLP input has the highest average correct gate rate, followed by the Wiki MLP input, the Character Attention input, and the Wiki Attention input. The plot also shows that the average correct gate rate fluctuates across the embedding layers, with some peaks and declines.
